findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 33 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. No other local invasion factors are identified. No lymph node metastases are present. Multiple hypodense nodules are scattered in the liver, suggesting multiple liver metastases. Additionally, multiple hypodense masses are observed in the spleen, raising suspicion of splenic metastases.
